en.s: On 28 January 814, Charlemagne died in Aachen, in present-day Germany. His son Louis the Pious succeeded him.

zh.s: 814年1月28日，查理曼在亚琛去世，其子虔诚者路易继位。亚琛位于今德国境内。

en.t: Fire at the Bal des Ardents in Paris
en.s: On 28 January 1393, costumes caught fire during a dance at the Bal des Ardents in Paris, France. Four dancers died, while King Charles VI survived.

zh.t: 巴黎“燃烧的舞会”发生火灾
zh.s: 1393年1月28日，法国巴黎“燃烧的舞会”上，舞者的服装起火，四名舞者死亡，国王查理六世幸免于难。

en.t: Edward VI, the nine-year-old son of Henry VIII, becomes King of England on his father's death
en.s: Edward VI (12 October 1537 – 6 July 1553) was King of England and Ireland from 28 January 1547 until his death in 1553. He was crowned on 20 February 1547 at the age of nine. The only surviving son of Henry VIII by his third wife, Jane Seymour, Edward was the first English monarch to be raised as a Protestant.

zh.t: 爱德华六世在父亲亨利八世去世后继位，成为英格兰国王
zh.s: 爱德华六世（1537年10月12日—1553年7月6日）于1547年1月28日至1553年去世期间担任英格兰和爱尔兰国王。他于1547年2月20日加冕，年仅9岁。他是亨利八世与第三任妻子简·西摩所生的唯一存活儿子，也是第一位自幼接受新教教育的英格兰君主。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.t: Execution of Agnes Sampson, accused of witchcraft in Edinburgh
en.s: Agnes Sampson (died 28 January 1591) was a Scottish healer and purported witch. Also known as the "Wise Wife of Keith", Sampson was executed during the North Berwick witch trials in the last decade of the 16th century.

zh.t: 艾格尼丝·桑普森被处决
zh.s: 苏格兰治疗师艾格尼丝·桑普森（1591年1月28日去世）也被称为“基思的智者妻子”，并被指控为女巫。她在16世纪末的北贝里克女巫审判期间被处决。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Udycz of 28 January 1606 was an engagement between the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth forces under hetman Stanisław Żółkiewski and the horde of Crimean Tatars under Khan Temir. Żółkiewski defeated Khan Temir's forces near Udych River (Удич).

zh.s: 1606年1月28日，波兰立陶宛联邦军与克里米亚鞑靼汗国军队在乌迪奇交战。斯坦尼斯瓦夫·若乌凯夫斯基统率联邦军，对阵帖木儿汗率领的部队，并在乌迪奇河附近击败了后者。

en.s: The Battle of Dartsedo was fought on January 28, 1701 between the Chinese and Tibetan armies over the control of the strategic border town of Dartsedo. The town of Dartsedo was an important trade center between Tibet and China, and for centuries its importance lay on the tea-horse trade. Sino-Tibetan trade in Dartsedo continued to expand as the demand for Chinese products in Tibet grew. The Tibetan interest in Dartsedo led to a growing official presence in the town and taking advantage of the anarchy that created after the fall of the Ming dynasty, the Tibetans took control of the town and stationed a garrison and officials in it.

zh.s: 1701年1月28日，清军与西藏军队为争夺边境战略重镇打箭炉而交战。打箭炉是西藏与内地之间的重要贸易中心，数百年来以茶马贸易著称。随着西藏对内地商品的需求增长，当地贸易不断扩大。西藏方面越来越重视打箭炉，派驻的官员也逐渐增多。明朝灭亡后，西藏方面乘局势混乱控制了该镇，并设置驻军和官员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Bali Strait incident was an encounter between a squadron of six French Navy frigates and six East Indiamen of the British East India Company (EIC) in the Bali Strait on 28 January 1797. The incident took place amidst the East Indies campaign of the French Revolutionary Wars — repeated French attempts to disrupt the highly valuable British trade routes with British India and Qing Dynasty China.

zh.s: 1797年1月28日，六艘法国海军护卫舰与六艘英国东印度公司商船在峇里海峡遭遇。这起事件发生在法国大革命战争的东印度战役期间；法国多次试图扰乱英国与英属印度和清朝中国之间价值极高的贸易航线。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Capture of Serampore (Danish: Overtagelsen af Frederiksnagore), also commonly known as the Second Capture of Serampure (Den anden overtagelse af Frederiksnagore), was a siege and capture of the Danish colony of Serampore by British forces on 28 January 1808. The Danes capitulated immediately after the arrival of the British, as the latter's forces were far superior.

zh.s: 塞兰坡攻占战（丹麦语：Overtagelsen af Frederiksnagore）也常称第二次攻占塞兰坡，是英国军队于1808年1月28日围攻并攻占丹麦殖民地塞兰坡的战斗。英军抵达后，丹麦守军立即投降，因为英军兵力远胜于丹麦军队。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: On 28 January 1813, Jane Austen’s novel Pride and Prejudice was published in the United Kingdom. The story follows Elizabeth Bennet and explores first impressions, social expectations and marriage.

zh.s: 1813年1月28日，简·奥斯汀的小说《傲慢与偏见》在英国出版。小说围绕伊丽莎白·班纳特展开，描写第一印象、社会期待与婚姻。

en.s: The Battle of Aliwal was fought on 28 January 1846 between the British and Sikh forces in northern India (now Punjab, India). The British were led by Sir Harry Smith, while the Sikhs were led by Ranjodh Singh Majithia. Britain's victory in the battle is sometimes regarded as the turning point in the First Anglo-Sikh War.

zh.s: 1846年1月28日，英国军队与锡克军队在印度北部、今天印度旁遮普邦境内的阿里瓦尔交战。英军由哈里·史密斯爵士指挥，锡克军由兰焦德·辛格·马吉蒂亚指挥。英军获胜，这场战役有时被视为第一次英锡战争的转折点。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The Battle of Awa (阿波沖海戦 Awa oki kaisen) occurred on 28 January 1868 during the Boshin War in Japan, in the area of Awa Bay near Osaka. Involving ships of the Tokugawa Shogunate and Satsuma vessels loyal to the imperial court in Kyoto, the battle was the second naval battle in Japanese history between modern naval forces (after the 1863 Battle of Shimonoseki Straits). Enomoto Takeaki led the Shogunal navy to victory at Awa, in one of the few Tokugawa successes of the Boshin War, one day after the start of the land Battle of Toba-Fushimi (which the Shogunate lost to the Imperial forces).

zh.s: 阿波海战发生于日本戊辰战争期间的1868年1月28日，地点在大阪附近的阿波湾海域。交战双方是德川幕府舰队和效忠京都朝廷的萨摩藩舰艇。这是继1863年下关海峡海战后，日本历史上第二次现代海军之间的海战。榎本武扬率幕府海军获胜，是德川一方在戊辰战争中为数不多的胜利之一。海战发生前一天，鸟羽伏见陆战爆发，幕府军在那场战斗中败给了朝廷军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Franco-Prussian War, occasionally known as the Franco-German War, and sometimes referred to in France as the War of 1870, was a conflict between France and the North German Confederation led by Prussia. Lasting from 19 July 1870 to 28 January 1871, the conflict was caused primarily by France's determination to reassert its dominant position in continental Europe, which appeared in question following the decisive Prussian victory over Austria in 1866.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 普法战争也称法德战争，法国有时称之为1870年战争，是法国与普鲁士领导的北德意志邦联之间的冲突。战争持续于1870年7月19日至1871年1月28日，主要起因是法国决心重新确立其在欧洲大陆的主导地位；1866年普鲁士大胜奥地利后，法国的地位似乎受到威胁。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Yale Daily News publishes its first issue
en.s: On January 28, 1878, the Yale Daily News published its inaugural issue in New Haven, Connecticut, United States.

zh.s: 1878年1月28日，《耶鲁每日新闻》在美国康涅狄格州纽黑文出版创刊号。

en.s: The Battle of Laing's Nek was a major battle fought at Laing's Nek during the First Boer War on 28 January 1881.

zh.s: 1881年1月28日，第一次布尔战争期间，双方在莱恩隘口展开一场重要战役。

en.t: 1885 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1885 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 37th Wisconsin Legislature on January 28, 1885. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator Angus Cameron did not run for re-election. Republican lawyer John Coit Spooner was elected United States senator on the first ballot. In the 1885 term, Republicans held significant majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, so had more than enough votes to elect a Republican United States senator.

zh.t: 1885年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1885年1月28日，第37届威斯康星州议会举行联邦参议员选举。共和党现任参议员安格斯·卡梅伦未寻求连任，共和党律师约翰·科伊特·斯普纳在首轮投票中当选。1885年任期内，共和党在州议会两院均占明显多数，拥有足够票数选出一名共和党联邦参议员。

en.t: 1885 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1885 United States Senate election in California was held on January 28, 1885, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 3) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. In a special joint session, former Republican Governor Leland Stanford was elected over former Democratic State Assemblyman George Hearst.

zh.t: 1885年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1885年1月28日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员选举，选出一名代表该州的第三组联邦参议员。在一次特别联席会议上，共和党前州长利兰·斯坦福击败民主党前州众议员乔治·赫斯特，当选联邦参议员。

en.t: 1891 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1891 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 40th Wisconsin Legislature on January 28, 1891. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator John C. Spooner ran for a second term, but lost the election to former U.S. postmaster general and U.S. secretary of the interior William F. Vilas. In the 1891 term, Democrats held significant majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, so had more than enough votes to elect a Democratic United States senator.

zh.t: 1891年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1891年1月28日，第40届威斯康星州议会举行联邦参议员选举。共和党现任参议员约翰·C.斯普纳争取第二个任期，却败给了曾任联邦邮政总长和内政部长的威廉·F.维拉斯。1891年任期内，民主党在州议会两院均占明显多数，拥有足够票数选出一名民主党联邦参议员。

en.t: 1891 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1891 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on January 28, 1891, to elect Kansas' Class III senator in its delegation.

zh.t: 1891年堪萨斯州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 堪萨斯州于1891年1月28日举行联邦参议员选举，选出代表该州的第三组参议员。

en.s: The Battle of Kuruyuki or Battle of Curuyuqui was fought near the town of Cuevo, Bolivia on January 28, 1892. The combatants were the Eastern Bolivian Guaraní (called Chiriguanos at that time) and a force made up of Bolivian military, militia, and Chiriguanos friendly to the government and Christianity. Often described as a massacre, the battle resulted in an overwhelming victory by the government forces.

zh.s: 1892年1月28日，库鲁尤基战役发生于玻利维亚库埃沃镇附近。交战一方是玻利维亚东部瓜拉尼人，当时被称为奇里瓜诺人；另一方由玻利维亚正规军、民兵，以及亲政府和支持基督教的奇里瓜诺人组成。政府军取得压倒性胜利，这场战斗也常被描述为一场屠杀。

en.s: The Dewsbury by-election, 1902 was a by-election held in England on 28 January 1902 for the House of Commons constituency of Dewsbury in the West Riding of Yorkshire.

zh.s: 1902年1月28日，英国下议院位于英格兰约克郡西区的迪斯伯里选区举行补选。

en.t: 1903 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1903 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 46th Wisconsin Legislature on January 28, 1903. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator John Coit Spooner was re-elected on the first ballot. In the 1903 term, Republicans held overwhelming majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, so had more than enough votes to elect a Republican United States senator.

zh.t: 1903年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1903年1月28日，第46届威斯康星州议会举行联邦参议员选举。共和党现任参议员约翰·科伊特·斯普纳在首轮投票中连任。1903年任期内，共和党在州议会两院均占压倒性多数，拥有足够票数选出一名共和党联邦参议员。

en.s: The Battle of Namutoni fought between the Ondonga kingdoms and German South West Africa on 28 January 1904 was part of an uprising against German colonial expansion catalysed by the Herero uprising to the south that started a few weeks earlier. It was fought at the site of Fort Namutoni in northern Namibia.

zh.s: 1904年1月28日，翁东加王国与德属西南非洲军队在纳穆托尼交战。这场战斗是反抗德国殖民扩张起义的一部分；南方几周前爆发的赫雷罗起义推动了这场反抗。战斗发生在纳米比亚北部的纳穆托尼堡。

en.s: The Municipal Library Elevator Coup (Portuguese: Golpe do Elevador da Biblioteca), also known as The Elevator Coup (Intentona do Elevador) or 28 January 1908 Coup (Golpe de 28 de Janeiro de 1908), was the name given for the attempted coup d'état in Lisbon, capital of Portugal, by members of the Portuguese Republican Party and Progressive Dissidency against the administrative dictatorship of Prime Minister João Franco (and the political ascendancy of the Liberal Regenerator Party).

zh.t: 市立图书馆升降机政变
zh.s: 市立图书馆升降机政变，也称升降机政变或1908年1月28日政变，是发生在葡萄牙首都里斯本的一次未遂政变。葡萄牙共和党和进步党异议派成员企图推翻总理若昂·佛朗哥的行政独裁统治，并结束自由复兴党在政治上的主导地位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: Louisiana Democrats held the party's gubernatorial primary. The nomination contest preceded the general election in April.

zh.t: 1908年路易斯安那州民主党州长初选
zh.s: 路易斯安那州民主党举行州长初选。这场党内提名竞争先于4月的正式选举。

en.t: 1913 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1913 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on January 28, 1913. Republican incumbent Frank O. Briggs ran for re-election to a second term, but was defeated by Democratic judge and former U.S. representative William Hughes. Prior to passage of the Seventeenth Amendment to the United States Constitution, New Jersey elected United States senators by a resolution of the New Jersey Legislature.

zh.t: 1913年新泽西州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1913年1月28日，新泽西州举行联邦参议员选举。共和党现任参议员弗兰克·O.布里格斯争取第二个任期，但败给了民主党法官、前联邦众议员威廉·休斯。在美国宪法第十七修正案通过前，新泽西州的联邦参议员由州议会通过决议选出。

en.t: Order of the White Rose of Finland established
en.s: On 28 January 1919, Regent Gustaf Mannerheim established the Order of the White Rose of Finland. Its statutes were ratified in May 1919.

zh.s: 1919年1月28日，芬兰摄政古斯塔夫·曼纳海姆设立白玫瑰勋章，相关章程于同年5月批准。

en.s: On January 28, 1922, snow brought down the roof of the Knickerbocker Theatre in Washington, D.C., United States, during a film screening. Ninety-eight people died.

zh.t: 尼克博克剧院屋顶坍塌
zh.s: 1922年1月28日，美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区尼克博克剧院在放映电影时，屋顶因积雪重压坍塌，98人死亡。

en.s: The Battle of Al-Regeai (Arabic: معركة الرقعي) also known as Battle of Atheriyat (named by the Ikhwan) in Kuwait was a fight between approximately 500 Ikhwan horsemen and the Kuwaiti military. It occurred on 28 January 1928. It was the final significant military engagement in Kuwait's early historical period. It transpired under the rule of Sheikh Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, the 10th ruler of the Sheikhdom of Kuwait.

zh.s: 1928年1月28日，约500名伊赫万骑兵与科威特军队发生拉盖战役，伊赫万方面称其为阿瑟里亚特战役。这是科威特早期历史中最后一次重要军事交战，发生于科威特酋长国第十任统治者艾哈迈德·贾比尔·萨巴赫执政期间。

en.s: The Battle of Kuhmo was a series of skirmishes, mainly between January 28 and March 13, 1940, near the town of Kuhmo during the Soviet-Finnish Winter War. The 54th Soviet Rifle Division was encircled, but was able to hold out until the end of the war.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 苏芬冬季战争期间，库赫莫附近于1940年1月28日至3月13日发生了一系列交火。苏联第54步兵师被包围，但仍坚持到战争结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: On 28 January 1941, a ceasefire paused hostilities in the Franco-Thai War in French Indochina, including territory in present-day Cambodia and Laos. Preliminary armistice documents were signed on January 31, and a peace treaty followed in May.

zh.s: 1941年1月28日，法泰战争停火，战区包括今柬埔寨和老挝境内。双方于1月31日签署初步停战文件，并于5月签订和平条约。

loc: 澳大利亚西澳大利亚州格雷戈里

en.s: The shelling of Port Gregory took place on 28 January 1943 during World War II. The attack was conducted by the Japanese submarine I-165 under the command of Lieutenant Commander Tatenosuke Tosu as part of the attempts to divert Allied attention away from the evacuation of Guadalcanal in the Solomon Islands. None of the ten shells fired at Port Gregory caused any damage, and the attack was not noticed by the Allied naval authorities until a radio signal sent by Tosu was intercepted and decoded a week later.

zh.s: 二战期间的1943年1月28日，日本伊165号潜艇在鸟巢建之助海军少佐指挥下炮击澳大利亚格雷戈里港，意在转移盟军对日军撤离所罗门群岛瓜达尔卡纳尔岛的注意。潜艇向港口发射十发炮弹，均未造成损失。盟军海军当局直到一周后截获并破译鸟巢发出的一则无线电信号，才得知这次袭击。

en.s: Local elections were held in Liechtenstein on 28 January 1945 to elect the municipal councils and the mayors of the eleven municipalities.

zh.s: 列支敦士登于1945年1月28日举行地方选举，选出全国11个市镇的议会和市镇长。

en.s: On January 28, 1947, Robert E. Jones Jr. was elected unopposed in the special election for Alabama’s 8th congressional district in the United States. He filled the vacancy left by John Sparkman’s resignation to become a US senator.

zh.t: 美国阿拉巴马州第八国会选区补选举行
zh.s: 1947年1月28日，罗伯特·E·琼斯在美国阿拉巴马州第八国会选区补选中无人竞争当选，填补约翰·斯帕克曼辞职转任联邦参议员留下的空缺。

en.s: Local elections were held in Liechtenstein on 28 January 1951 to elect the municipal councils and the mayors of the eleven municipalities.

zh.s: 列支敦士登于1951年1月28日举行地方选举，选出全国11个市镇的议会和市镇长。

en.t: Dammam conference discusses the Buraimi dispute
en.s: On 28 January 1952, a conference on the Buraimi dispute was held in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. The Saudi foreign minister, the rulers of Abu Dhabi and Qatar, and British political resident Bernard Burrows attended. The talks did not resolve the dispute.

zh.t: 达曼会议讨论布赖米争端
zh.s: 1952年1月28日，沙特阿拉伯达曼举行会议，讨论布赖米争端。沙特外交大臣、阿布扎比与卡塔尔的统治者，以及英国政治驻扎官伯纳德·伯罗斯出席。谈判未能解决争端。

en.t: NFL approves Dallas and Minnesota expansion franchises
en.s: On January 28, 1960, NFL owners meeting in Miami, Florida, United States, approved expansion franchises for Dallas to begin play in 1960 and Minnesota in 1961.

zh.t: NFL批准达拉斯与明尼苏达扩军球队
zh.s: 1960年1月28日，NFL球队老板在美国佛罗里达州迈阿密开会，批准达拉斯和明尼苏达加入联盟，两队分别从1960年和1961年开始参赛。

en.s: On 28 January 1964, an unarmed T-39 Sabreliner aircraft of the United States Air Force (USAF) was shot down while on a training mission over Erfurt, East Germany, by a MiG-19 jet fighter of the Soviet Air Force. The occupants of the aircraft were Lieutenant Colonel Gerald K. Hannaford, Captain Donald Grant Millard, and Captain John F. Lorraine. All three died, becoming direct casualties of the Cold War in Europe.

zh.s: 1964年1月28日，美国空军一架未携带武器的T-39“军刀客”教练机在东德埃尔福特上空执行训练任务时，被苏联空军一架米格-19战斗机击落。机上三人——杰拉尔德·K·汉纳福德中校、唐纳德·格兰特·米勒德上尉和约翰·F·洛兰上尉——全部遇难，成为冷战期间欧洲的直接受害者。

en.s: The first round Scottish Cup match between Berwick Rangers and Rangers was a football match played on 28 January 1967. Berwick Rangers ran out 1–0 winners. The match has been described as one of the biggest upsets in Scottish football.

zh.t: 伯威克流浪者足球俱乐部 1–0 格拉斯哥流浪者足球俱乐部
zh.s: 1967年1月28日，伯威克流浪者队与格拉斯哥流浪者队在苏格兰杯首轮交手。伯威克流浪者以1比0获胜，这场比赛被称为苏格兰足球史上最大的冷门之一。

en.s: General elections were held in Senegal on 28 January 1973 to elect a President and National Assembly. At the time the country was a one-party state, with the Senegalese Progressive Union (UPS) as the sole legal party, As a result, its leader, Léopold Sédar Senghor, was the only candidate in the presidential election and was re-elected unopposed. In the National Assembly election, voters were presented with a list of 100 UPS candidates (for the 100 seats) to vote for. Voter turnout was 93.0% in the parliamentary elections and 97% in the presidential election.

zh.s: 塞内加尔于1973年1月28日举行总统和国民议会选举。当时该国实行一党制，塞内加尔进步联盟是唯一合法政党。因此，该党领袖利奥波德·塞达尔·桑戈尔是唯一总统候选人，在没有对手的情况下连任。国民议会选举中，选民只能对进步联盟提出的100人名单投票，议会共有100个席位。议会选举投票率为93.0%，总统选举为97%。

en.s: Local elections were held in Liechtenstein on 28 January 1979 to elect the municipal councils and the mayors of the eleven municipalities. Women were able to vote in Vaduz for first time.

zh.s: 列支敦士登于1979年1月28日举行地方选举，选出全国11个市镇的议会和市镇长。瓦杜兹的女性首次有权投票。

en.t: Wrestling Star Wars held in Fort Worth
en.s: On January 28, 1985, World Class Championship Wrestling held a Wrestling Star Wars show at the Fort Worth Convention Center in Fort Worth, Texas, United States. Several matches were recorded for television broadcasts in the following weeks.

zh.t: “Wrestling Star Wars”赛事在沃思堡举行
zh.s: 1985年1月28日，WCCW在美国得克萨斯州沃思堡会议中心举办“Wrestling Star Wars”职业摔角赛事。部分比赛被录制下来，在随后几周的电视节目中播出。

en.s: STS-51-L was the 25th flight of the American Space Shuttle program, and the tenth mission of the Space Shuttle Challenger, which lifted-off from Launch Complex 39-B, at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida, on January 28, 1986. The mission ended in catastrophic failure with the destruction of Challenger, starting at 73 seconds after lift-off, and the death of all seven crew members. The Rogers Commission determined that the cause of the destruction was due to the failure of an O-ring seal on the starboard Solid Rocket Booster (SRB). This flight marked the first time a non-government civilian, schoolteacher Christa McAuliffe, had flown aboard the Space Shuttle.

zh.s: STS-51-L是美国航天飞机计划的第25次飞行，也是挑战者号航天飞机的第十次任务。挑战者号于1986年1月28日从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心39-B发射台升空，升空73秒后开始解体，七名机组成员全部遇难。罗杰斯委员会认定，事故原因是右侧固体火箭助推器上的O形密封圈失效。这次飞行也是首位非政府雇员的普通公民——教师克里斯塔·麦考利夫——搭乘航天飞机。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On January 28, 1986, Space Shuttle Challenger broke apart 73 seconds into its flight, killing all seven crew members. The spacecraft disintegrated about 46,000 feet (14 km) above the Atlantic Ocean, off the coast of Cape Canaveral, Florida, at 16:39:13 UTC (11:39:13 a.m. EST, local time at the launch site). It was the first fatal accident involving an American spacecraft while in flight.

zh.t: 挑战者号航天飞机灾难
zh.s: 1986年1月28日，挑战者号航天飞机升空73秒后解体，机上7名机组人员全部遇难。当地时间上午11时39分13秒（UTC 16时39分13秒），飞船在佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角外的大西洋上空约4.6万英尺（14公里）处解体。这是美国航天器在飞行中发生的首起致命事故。

en.s: The 1990 Saarland state election was held on 28 January 1990 to elect the members of the Landtag of Saarland. The incumbent Social Democratic Party (SPD) government led by Minister-President Oskar Lafontaine was returned with an increased majority and continued in office.

zh.s: 萨尔州于1990年1月28日举行州议会选举。由州长奥斯卡·拉方丹领导的社会民主党政府赢得更多议席，成功连任并继续执政。

en.s: The 1995 Sulabayan by-election is a by-election for the Sabah State Legislative Assembly seat of Sulabayan that were held on 28 January 1995. It was called following the resignation of the incumbent, Sakaran Dandai on 27 December 1994.

zh.s: 马来西亚沙巴州议会苏拉巴央选区于1995年1月28日举行补选。补选因现任议员沙卡兰·丹代于1994年12月27日辞职而举行。

en.s: On January 28, 1996, Pancrase: Truth 1 took place at Yokohama Cultural Gymnasium in Yokohama, Japan.

zh.s: 1996年1月28日，Pancrase“Truth 1”赛事在日本横滨文化体育馆举行。

en.s: The Giant Baba Memorial Spectacular was a professional wrestling memorial event produced by the All-Japan Pro Wrestling (AJPW) promotion, which took place on January 28, 2001 at the Tokyo Egg Dome in Tokyo, Japan. It was the first memorial event held in memory of AJPW founder Shohei "Giant" Baba since his death in 1999, and subsequently followed by the Giant Baba Memorial Cup and Giant Baba Memorial Six Man Tag Team Tournament a year later. Ten professional wrestling matches were featured on the event's card, with two including championships.

zh.t: 巨人马场纪念摔角大赛
zh.s: 全日本职业摔角于2001年1月28日在日本东京巨蛋举办巨人马场纪念大赛。这是该组织创办人“巨人”马场正平于1999年去世后，首次为他举行的纪念赛事。之后又举办了巨人马场纪念杯，并在一年后举行巨人马场纪念六人组队赛。本场赛事共安排十场职业摔角比赛，其中两场争夺冠军。

en.s: TAME Flight 120 was a Boeing 727-134 airliner, registration HC-BLF, named El Oro, operating as a scheduled international passenger flight between Quito, Ecuador and Cali, Colombia, with a scheduled stopover at the Ecuadorian border town of Tulcán. The aircraft crashed while on approach to Tulcán's Teniente Coronel Luis A. Mantilla International Airport on January 28, 2002.

zh.s: TAME航空120号班机由一架注册号HC-BLF、名为“埃尔奥罗”的波音727-134客机执飞，原定从厄瓜多尔基多飞往哥伦比亚卡利，中途在厄瓜多尔边境城镇图尔坎停留。飞机于2002年1月28日进近图尔坎特尼恩特·科罗内尔·路易斯·A·曼蒂利亚国际机场时坠毁。

en.t: Orange County Third District supervisor special election
en.s: On January 28, 2003, a special election was held for the Third District seat on the Orange County Board of Supervisors in California, United States. Bill Campbell won the seat left vacant by Todd Spitzer.

zh.t: 美国橙县第三选区县政委员补选举行
zh.s: 2003年1月28日，美国加利福尼亚州橙县举行第三选区县政委员补选，比尔·坎贝尔赢得托德·斯皮策留下的席位。

en.s: La Copa Junior (2005) (Spanish for "The Junior Cup") was a professional wrestling tournament produced and scripted by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council"). The tournament ran from January 28, 2005 to February 11, 2005 in Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico. CMLL's recurring La Copa Junior tournament featured second, third or fourth generation wrestlers completing against each other.

zh.s: 2005年摔角后代杯是墨西哥世界摔角理事会（CMLL）制作并编排的职业摔角锦标赛，于1月28日至2月11日在墨西哥城墨西哥竞技场举行。这项定期举办的赛事由出身摔角世家的第二代、第三代或第四代选手相互较量。

en.s: A leadership spill of the Australian Labor Party (ALP), the official opposition party in the Parliament of Australia, was held on 28 January 2005. The outgoing Opposition Leader, Mark Latham, stood down 13 months after assuming the leadership in December 2003. Kim Beazley was the only contender for the ballot, and was therefore elected unopposed.

zh.s: 澳大利亚议会反对党工党于2005年1月28日举行党魁选举。即将卸任的反对党领袖马克·莱瑟姆在上任13个月后辞职。金·比兹利是唯一候选人，因此未经对手挑战便当选。

en.s: Royal Rumble (2007) was the twentieth annual Royal Rumble professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). It took place on January 28, 2007, at the AT&T Center in San Antonio, Texas and featured talent from the Raw, SmackDown! and ECW brands. This marked the first time that the new ECW brand participated in the Royal Rumble match. As has been customary since 1993, the Royal Rumble match winner received a match at that year's WrestleMania, (in this instance: WrestleMania 23) for his choice at either the WWE Championship, the World Heavyweight Championship or the ECW World Championship.

zh.s: 2007年皇家大战是世界摔角娱乐公司（WWE）举办的第20届年度职业摔角按次付费赛事，于1月28日在美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥AT&T中心举行，参赛选手来自Raw、SmackDown!和ECW品牌。这是新ECW品牌首次参加皇家大战淘汰赛。按照自1993年以来的惯例，淘汰赛胜者可在当年的摔角狂热大赛中挑战一项冠军。本届胜者可在第23届摔角狂热大赛中，选择挑战WWE冠军、世界重量级冠军或ECW世界冠军。

en.s: The Batu Talam by-election was held on 28 January 2007. The seat of Batu Talam in the state assembly of Pahang, Malaysia, fell vacant after the death of the incumbent, Tengku Paris Tengku Razlan of the United Malays National Organisation (UMNO), the leading party of the ruling Barisan Nasional. Nominations were held on 16 January, with two candidates filing to contest — Abdul Aziz Mat Kiram of UMNO, and independent candidate Ng Chee Pang.

zh.s: 马来西亚彭亨州峇都达南选区于2007年1月28日举行补选。时任国阵主要成员党巫统议员东姑帕里斯·东姑拉兹兰去世后，州议会席位出缺。提名于1月16日举行，两名候选人参选：巫统的阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹·马特·基拉姆和独立候选人黄志鹏。

en.s: The 2007 Liechtenstein local elections were held on 28 January to elect the municipal councils and the mayors of the eleven municipalities of Liechtenstein.

zh.s: 列支敦士登于1月28日举行2007年地方选举，选出全国11个市镇的市议会和市长。

en.s: United: NYC was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Dragon Gate USA that was second live Internet pay-per-view. It took place on January 28, 2011 at B.B. King's Blues Club & Grill in New York, New York.

zh.s: “联合大赛：纽约”是美国龙门摔角组织举办的职业摔角按次付费赛事，也是该组织第二场网络按次付费直播赛事。比赛于2011年1月28日在纽约市B.B.金蓝调俱乐部餐厅举行。

en.t: Indian Navy fights pirates off Minicoy
en.s: On 28 January 2011, the Indian Navy patrol vessel INS Cankarso fought pirates aboard the fishing trawler Prantalay 14 off Minicoy Island in the Indian Ocean. The trawler sank and twenty captives were rescued.

zh.t: 印度海军在米尼科伊岛外海与海盗交战
zh.s: 2011年1月28日，印度海军巡逻艇“Cankarso”号在印度洋米尼科伊岛外海，与盘踞在“Prantalay 14”号渔船上的海盗交战。渔船沉没，20名被扣人员获救。

en.s: The 2012 W-League grand final was the grand final of the fourth season of the Australian W-League football (soccer) competition. It was contested between premiers Canberra United and second-placed Brisbane Roar at McKellar Park in Canberra on Saturday, 28 January 2012. Canberra United were victorious, winning 3–2.

zh.t: 2012年澳大利亚女足联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2012年澳大利亚女足联赛总决赛是这项赛事第四个赛季的最终决赛，于2012年1月28日星期六在堪培拉麦凯勒公园球场举行。常规赛冠军堪培拉联对阵排名第二的布里斯班狮吼，最终堪培拉联以3比2获胜。

en.s: On 28 January 2012, voting took place for the 60 seats of the Manipur Legislative Assembly in India.

zh.t: 印度曼尼普尔邦议会选举投票举行
zh.s: 2012年1月28日，印度曼尼普尔邦举行邦议会选举投票，选出60名议员。

en.s: It's Showtime 2012 in Leeuwarden or It's Showtime 54 & 55 was a kickboxing event held on January 28, 2012, at the WTC Expo in Leeuwarden, Netherlands.

zh.s: 2012年吕伐登“Showtime”赛事，也称“Showtime 54 & 55”，是一场踢拳赛事，于2012年1月28日在荷兰吕伐登的WTC展览中心举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: UFC on Fox 2: Evans vs. Davis
en.s: On January 28, 2012, UFC on Fox 2: Evans vs. Davis took place at the United Center in Chicago, Illinois, United States.

zh.t: UFC on Fox 2：埃文斯对戴维斯
zh.s: 2012年1月28日，UFC on Fox第2期“埃文斯对戴维斯”综合格斗赛在美国伊利诺伊州芝加哥的联合中心举行。

en.t: Liberal Democrat MPs elect Malcolm Bruce as deputy leader
en.s: Liberal Democrat members of the UK House of Commons voted to choose the party's deputy leader. Malcolm Bruce won on the second round of voting.

zh.t: 英国自由民主党议员选举副党魁马尔科姆·布鲁斯
zh.s: 英国下议院自由民主党议员投票选出副党魁。马尔科姆·布鲁斯在第二轮投票中获胜。

en.t: UFC on Fox: Shevchenko vs. Peña
en.s: UFC on Fox: Shevchenko vs. Peña (also known as UFC on Fox 23) was a mixed martial arts event promoted by the Ultimate Fighting Championship held on January 28, 2017, at Pepsi Center in Denver, Colorado.

zh.t: UFC福克斯之夜：舍甫琴科对佩娜
zh.s: “UFC福克斯之夜：舍甫琴科对佩娜”也称UFC福克斯之夜23，是终极格斗冠军赛于2017年1月28日在美国科罗拉多州丹佛百事中心举办的综合格斗赛事。

en.s: NXT TakeOver: San Antonio was a 2017 professional wrestling livestreaming event produced by WWE, held exclusively for wrestlers from the promotion's developmental brand, NXT. It was the 13th NXT TakeOver event and took place on Saturday, January 28, 2017, at the Freeman Coliseum in San Antonio, Texas. The event aired exclusively on the WWE Network and was held as part of that year's Royal Rumble weekend, thus being the first NXT TakeOver to be held in January.

zh.s: “NXT接管：圣安东尼奥”是WWE于2017年举办的职业摔角网络直播赛事，专供旗下发展品牌NXT的选手参赛。这是第13场NXT接管赛事，于2017年1月28日星期六在美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥弗里曼体育馆举行，由WWE Network独家播出。赛事属于当年皇家大战周末的活动，也是首次在1月举行的NXT接管赛事。

en.t: Fight Nights Global 58: Brandão vs. Machaev
en.s: On January 28, 2017, Fight Nights Global 58: Brandão vs. Machaev took place at Ali Aliyev Sports Palace in Kaspiysk, Russia.

zh.t: Fight Nights Global 58：布兰当对马恰耶夫
zh.s: 2017年1月28日，Fight Nights Global第58期“布兰当对马恰耶夫”综合格斗赛在俄罗斯卡斯皮斯克的阿里·阿利耶夫体育宫举行。

en.s: The first round of a by-election was held in Territoire de Belfort's 1st constituency on 28 January 2018, with a second round on 4 February because no candidate secured a majority of votes in the first round. The by-election was called due to the invalidation of the election of Ian Boucard, candidate of The Republicans (LR), in the June 2017 legislative elections by the Constitutional Council on 8 December 2017, due to the distribution of misleading electoral leaflets by Boucard's campaign between the two rounds.

zh.t: 2018年贝尔福地区省第一选区补选
zh.s: 法国贝尔福地区省第一选区于2018年1月28日举行补选首轮投票。由于无人获得过半选票，第二轮投票于2月4日举行。此前，共和党候选人伊昂·布卡尔在2017年6月议会选举中当选，但其团队在两轮投票之间散发误导性竞选传单，宪法委员会因此于2017年12月8日裁定其当选无效，随后举行补选。

en.s: The 2018 Lower Austrian state election was held on 28 January 2018 to elect the members of the Landtag of Lower Austria. The ruling Austrian People's Party (ÖVP) fell just short of an absolute majority of votes, but retained its majority in the Landtag. Nonetheless, this was its worst result in the state since 1998.

zh.s: 下奥地利州于2018年1月28日举行州议会选举。执政的奥地利人民党得票率略低于过半门槛，但仍保住了州议会多数席位。尽管如此，这仍是该党自1998年以来在该州取得的最差成绩。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cyprus on 28 January 2018. As no candidate received a majority of the vote in the first round, a run-off was held on 4 February between the top two candidates, incumbent President Nicos Anastasiades of the Democratic Rally (DISY) and Stavros Malas of the Progressive Party of Working People. Anastasiades emerged as the winner with 55.99% of the vote.

zh.s: 塞浦路斯于2018年1月28日举行总统选举。由于首轮无人获得过半选票，得票最多的两名候选人于2月4日进入第二轮：民主大会党的现任总统尼科斯·阿纳斯塔夏季斯，对阵劳动人民进步党的斯塔夫罗斯·马拉斯。阿纳斯塔夏季斯最终以55.99%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The first round of a by-election was held in Val-d'Oise's 1st constituency on 28 January 2018, with a second round on 4 February because no candidate secured a majority of votes in the first round. The by-election was called due to the invalidation of the election of Isabelle Muller-Quoy, candidate of La République En Marche! (REM), in the June 2017 legislative elections by the Constitutional Council on 16 November 2017.

zh.t: 2018年瓦兹河谷省第一选区补选
zh.s: 法国瓦兹河谷省第一选区于2018年1月28日举行补选首轮投票。由于无人获得过半选票，第二轮投票于2月4日举行。此前，共和国前进党候选人伊莎贝尔·米勒-夸在2017年6月议会选举中当选，宪法委员会于同年11月16日裁定其当选无效，因而举行此次补选。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Finland on 28 January 2018. The incumbent Sauli Niinistö received 63% of the vote and was re-elected for a second term, avoiding a second round. He received a plurality of the vote in every municipality and a majority in all but 13 municipalities. Niinistö's second term was from 1 February 2018 to 1 March 2024.

zh.s: 芬兰于2018年1月28日举行总统选举。现任总统绍利·尼尼斯托获得63%的选票，直接赢得第二个任期，无须进行第二轮投票。他在全国每个市镇的得票都居首位，且仅在13个市镇未能获得过半选票。他的第二个任期从2018年2月1日持续至2024年3月1日。

en.s: The 39th Yokohama Film Festival (第３９回ヨコハマ映画祭) was held on 28 January 2018 at Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan. The awards ceremony was held in the city's Kanagawa Prefectural Music Hall, the results having been announced on 2 December 2018.

zh.s: 第39届横滨电影节于2018年1月28日在日本神奈川县横滨市举行，颁奖典礼设在市内的神奈川县立音乐堂。原文将获奖结果公布日期写为2018年12月2日，与其所述的颁奖先后顺序不一致。

en.s: The 2018 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE, held for wrestlers from the promotion's main roster brands, Raw and SmackDown. It was the 31st annual Royal Rumble event and took place on January 28, 2018, at the Wells Fargo Center in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. This was the third Royal Rumble held at the venue, after the 2004 event, when it was known as the Wachovia Center, and the 2015 event.

zh.s: 2018年皇家大战是WWE举办的职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事，参赛选手来自其主力品牌Raw和SmackDown。这是第31届皇家大战，于2018年1月28日在美国宾夕法尼亚州费城富国银行中心举行。该场馆此前在2004年和2015年举办过皇家大战，2004年时场馆还名为美联银行中心，此次为第三次承办。

en.s: The 2018 Sundance Film Festival took place from January 18 to January 28, 2018. The first lineup of competition films was announced on November 29, 2017. There was some degree of tension with this particular year's event, as Robert Redford addressed concerns about alleged assault accusations against Harvey Weinstein, and the event's organizers took measures to improve the safety of guests.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2018年圣丹斯电影节于2018年1月18日至28日举行。首批竞赛影片名单于2017年11月29日公布。该届电影节期间有一些紧张气氛：罗伯特·雷德福回应了哈维·韦恩斯坦性侵指控引发的担忧，主办方也采取措施保障嘉宾安全。

en.s: The 16th Mumbai International Film Festival (Mumbai International Film Festival) was held from 28 January to 3 February 2020. The list included various kind of Documentaries, short fiction and animation films. The festival also celebrated the birth centenary of Satyajit Ray by showcasing documentaries made by him including short film Pikoo (1980), Sukumar Ray (1987) and The Inner Eye (1972).
en.n: This entry records the opening, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第16届孟买国际电影节于2020年1月28日至2月3日举行，展映了纪录片、剧情短片和动画片等作品。电影节还纪念萨蒂亚吉特·雷伊诞辰100周年，放映了他执导的纪录片及短片，包括《皮库》（1980年）、《苏库马尔·雷伊》（1987年）和《内心之眼》（1972年）。

en.s: The 2021 Georgia poultry plant accident was an industrial disaster that occurred on January 28, 2021, in Gainesville, Georgia, United States. Six people were killed by asphyxiation and at least ten were injured when a liquid nitrogen leak occurred inside a poultry processing plant owned by Foundation Food Group.

zh.t: 2021年佐治亚州家禽加工厂事故
zh.s: 2021年1月28日，美国佐治亚州盖恩斯维尔一家家禽加工厂发生工业事故。基金会食品集团工厂内液氮泄漏，造成6人窒息死亡，至少10人受伤。

en.s: The 21st Extraordinary Congress of the Nur Otan Party (Kazakh: «Нұр Отан» партиясының кезектен тыс XXI съезі, romanized: «Nūr Otan» partiiasynyñ kezekten tys XXI sezı; Russian: XXI внеочередной съезд партии «Нур Отан») was held remotely on 28 January 2022 to elect the new chairman of Nur Otan after former President Nursultan Nazarbayev announced in stepping down from leading the largest ruling party in Kazakhstan for more than 20 years in November 2021 and the days of turmoil conflict that took place in early January.

zh.t: 努尔奥坦党第21次特别代表大会
zh.s: 努尔奥坦党于2022年1月28日以远程方式召开第21次特别代表大会，选举新任党主席。此前，前总统努尔苏丹·纳扎尔巴耶夫于2021年11月宣布卸任执政党主席；2022年1月初哈萨克斯坦又发生动荡和冲突。

en.s: On January 28, 2022, ACA 135: Gasanov vs. Dzhanaev took place at Sports Hall Coliseum in Grozny, Russia.

zh.s: 2022年1月28日，ACA第135期“加萨诺夫对贾纳耶夫”综合格斗赛在俄罗斯格罗兹尼的Coliseum体育馆举行。

en.s: On January 28, 2022, Eagle FC 44: Spong vs. Kharitonov took place at FLXcast Arena in Miami, Florida, United States.

zh.t: Eagle FC 44：斯庞对哈里托诺夫
zh.s: 2022年1月28日，Eagle FC第44期“斯庞对哈里托诺夫”综合格斗赛在美国佛罗里达州迈阿密的FLXcast Arena举行。

en.s: ONE: Only the Brave was a Combat sport event produced by ONE Championship that took place on January 28, 2022, at the Singapore Indoor Stadium in Kallang, Singapore.

zh.s: ONE：勇者无惧是ONE冠军赛主办的格斗赛事，于2022年1月28日在新加坡加冷的新加坡室内体育馆举行。

en.s: On January 28, 2022, AMC Fight Nights 108 took place at the Aquarium Arena in Crocus Expo, Krasnogorsk, Russia.

zh.t: AMC Fight Nights第108期赛事举行
zh.s: 2022年1月28日，AMC Fight Nights第108期综合格斗赛在俄罗斯克拉斯诺戈尔斯克的Crocus Expo展览中心Aquarium Arena举行。

en.s: On January 28, 2023, suspected Islamic State jihadists attacked Burkinabe soldiers and Volunteers for the Defense of the Homeland (VDP) militiamen in the city of Falagountou, Burkina Faso.

zh.s: 2023年1月28日，疑似“伊斯兰国”武装人员在布基纳法索法拉贡图市，袭击了该国士兵和保卫祖国志愿军民兵。

en.s: The 2023 Royal Rumble was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the 36th annual Royal Rumble and took place on January 28, 2023, at the Alamodome in San Antonio, Texas, as part of the Alamodome's 30th-anniversary celebration, held for wrestlers from all three of WWE's brand divisions.

zh.s: 2023年皇家大战是WWE举办的职业摔角按次付费及网络直播赛事。这是第36届皇家大战，于2023年1月28日在美国得克萨斯州圣安东尼奥阿拉莫穹顶体育馆举行，也是该馆启用30周年庆祝活动的一部分。WWE旗下三个品牌的摔角选手均可参赛。

en.s: A supplementary election was held in the district of Narracan on 28 January 2023, to elect a member for the district to the Victorian Legislative Assembly. Six days before the 2022 Victorian state election, the Nationals candidate for Narracan was found dead. According to Victorian electoral law, the lower house election in Narracan was declared failed, with a supplementary election triggered.

zh.s: 澳大利亚维多利亚州纳拉坎选区于2023年1月28日举行补选，选出州立法议会议员。2022年维多利亚州选举前六天，国家党纳拉坎选区候选人被发现死亡。根据维多利亚州选举法，该选区的下议院选举被宣布无效，因此举行补选。

en.s: The 2023 Taça da Liga final was the final match of the 2022–23 Taça da Liga, the sixteenth season of the Taça da Liga. It was played on 28 January 2023 at Estádio Dr. Magalhães Pessoa. The competition involved the 34 clubs playing in the top two tiers of the Portuguese football league system – 18 from Primeira Liga and 16 from Liga Portugal 2 – during the 2022–23 season.

zh.s: 2023年葡萄牙联赛杯决赛是2022—2023赛季葡萄牙联赛杯的决赛，也是该赛事第16届比赛的收官战。比赛于2023年1月28日在莱里亚的马加良斯·佩索阿博士体育场举行。该赛季共有34支葡萄牙足球联赛前两级球队参赛，其中葡超18队、葡甲16队。

en.s: The 2023 Supercopa do Brasil (officially the Supercopa Betano do Brasil 2023 for sponsorship reasons) was the sixth edition of Supercopa do Brasil, an annual football match played between the champions of the Campeonato Brasileiro Série A and Copa do Brasil. The match was played on 28 January 2023 between Palmeiras and Flamengo, who qualified after winning the 2022 Campeonato Brasileiro Série A and the 2022 Copa do Brasil, respectively.

zh.s: 2023年巴西超级杯是第六届巴西超级杯，正式名称为“巴西超级杯Betano 2023”。这项年度足球赛事由巴西甲级联赛冠军对阵巴西杯冠军。比赛于2023年1月28日举行，参赛双方是2022年巴西甲级联赛冠军帕尔梅拉斯和2022年巴西杯冠军弗拉门戈。

en.s: On 28 January 2023, the final of the 2022 Empress’s Cup, Japan’s women’s football tournament, was played at Yodoko Sakura Stadium in Osaka, Japan.

zh.s: 2023年1月28日，2022年日本女子足球皇后杯决赛在日本大阪的淀川制钢樱花体育场举行。

en.s: On January 28, 2023, Glory and War of Nation held the Glory Rivals 5 kickboxing event at Zamna Tulum in Tulum, Mexico.

zh.s: 2023年1月28日，Glory与War of Nation在墨西哥图卢姆的Zamna Tulum举办Glory Rivals第5期踢拳赛。

en.t: Road to DFS 1: Lambagiu vs. Guiderdone
en.s: On January 28, 2023, Dynamite Fighting Show and Thai Boxe Mania held Road to DFS 1: Lambagiu vs. Guiderdone, a kickboxing and Muay Thai event, at Palasport di Torino in Turin, Italy.

zh.t: Road to DFS 1：兰巴久对圭德多内
zh.s: 2023年1月28日，Dynamite Fighting Show与Thai Boxe Mania在意大利都灵体育宫举办“Road to DFS 1：兰巴久对圭德多内”踢拳及泰拳赛事。

en.s: On January 28, 2023, the RISE 164 kickboxing event took place at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

zh.s: 2023年1月28日，RISE第164期踢拳赛在日本东京后乐园大厅举行。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Finland on 28 January 2024, with a second round held on 11 February. Voters elected a president of the Republic for a six-year term. Incumbent president Sauli Niinistö was term-limited and ineligible to run for re-election, having served the maximum two terms, ensuring that the president elected would be the country's thirteenth.

zh.s: 芬兰于2024年1月28日举行总统选举，第二轮投票在2月11日举行，选出任期六年的共和国总统。现任总统绍利·尼尼斯托已任满最多两届，受任期限制不能再次参选，因此新当选者将成为芬兰第13任总统。

en.s: The 2024 Super Cup final was the final match of the 2024 Super Cup, the fourth edition of the Super Cup. It was played at Kalinga Stadium in Bhubaneswar on 28 January 2024 between East Bengal and Odisha. East Bengal won the match 3–2 for their ninth national cup title and the first major title in 12 years.

zh.s: 2024年印度超级杯决赛是第四届超级杯的最后一场比赛，于1月28日在布巴内斯瓦尔卡林加体育场举行，由东孟加拉对阵奥迪沙。东孟加拉以3比2获胜，获得队史第九个全国杯赛冠军，也是球队12年来首个重要赛事冠军。

en.s: ONE 165: Superlek vs. Takeru was a combat sport event produced by ONE Championship that took place on January 28, 2024, at the Ariake Arena in Tokyo, Japan.

zh.s: ONE 165：苏泊克对阵武尊是ONE冠军赛主办的格斗赛事，于2024年1月28日在日本东京有明竞技场举行。

en.s: On 28 January 2026, a Learjet 45 operated by VSR Ventures crashed during a charter flight from Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport in Mumbai to Baramati Airport in Maharashtra, India, killing the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, Ajit Pawar, as well as all four other occupants. The crash was determined to be in low visibility and heavy fog.

zh.t: 2026年巴拉马蒂里尔45型飞机坠毁事故
zh.s: 2026年1月28日，VSR Ventures公司运营的一架里尔45型飞机执行从印度孟买贾特拉帕蒂·希瓦吉国际机场飞往马哈拉施特拉邦巴拉马蒂机场的包机航班时坠毁。机上的马哈拉施特拉邦副首席部长阿吉特·帕瓦尔及其余四人全部遇难。事故发生时有浓雾，能见度很低。
